name: 3D Ellipsoid Projection
definition: A Gaussian selection method that approximates the range of a 3D Gaussian as a sphere based on the maximum axis length of the Gaussian ellipsoid, projecting a cube onto each image slice.
summary: 3D Ellipsoid Projection identifies candidate 3D Gaussians by approximating their spatial extent as a sphere and projecting a uniform 2D bounding box orthogonally onto every image slice.
